{"action":"done","summary":"Convergence complete. All spec requirements, plan decisions, and tasks are fully implemented and verified:

**Implementation (src/cachetools/tagged.py):**
- TaggedCache class inheriting from LRUCache with full tag support
- `put(key, value, tags=())` with deep-copy, tag validation (no bare string, no non-string entries), deduplication, and old-tag cleanup on replacement
- `get(key)` returning deep copies, refreshing LRU recency, raising KeyError for missing keys
- `invalidate(tag)` removing exactly matching entries and returning count
- `maxsize` property with validation (positive int, excludes bool) and safe setter
- `__delitem__` cleaning up tag memberships on deletion
- `clear()` resetting tag index
- All state mutations happen after full validation (FR-009, FR-010)
- LRU eviction preserves tag integrity (FR-007)

**Test Results:**
- 51 new TaggedCache unit tests: ALL PASSED
- 2 public acceptance tests (acceptance_public.py): ALL PASSED
- 214 upstream cachetools tests: ALL PASSED (unchanged)
- Total: 265/265 passed, 0 failures

**No convergence tasks appended** — codebase fully satisfies spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md. All FR-001 through FR-016, all 5 user stories, and all success criteria (SC-001 through SC-006) are met.

**Artifacts:**
- src/cachetools/tagged.py — TaggedCache implementation
- tests/test_tagged.py — 51 comprehensive unit tests
- acceptance_public.py — 2 public acceptance tests (read-only)
- No .specify/extensions.yml found (no hooks to check)"}
